name: Sugar Rush

features.name: Multiplier spots
features.description: When a winning symbol explodes its grid position is marked; a second win on the same spot starts a multiplier that doubles each time, up to 128x.

features.name: Free spins
features.description: 3–7 scatters award 10–30 free spins, and marked spots and multipliers stay on the grid for the whole round.

review: Sugar Rush swaps the pay-anywhere model for cluster pays on a 7x7 grid and adds a clever spot-multiplier system. Each win leaves a mark on the grid, and repeat wins on the same spot double a multiplier all the way to 128x. In the base game the marks reset after each spin; in free spins they persist, so a well-covered grid late in the bonus is where big results come from. It's one of the more satisfying Pragmatic engines to watch build up.
pros: Multiplier grid is easy to follow and builds tension
cons: Bonuses that never get going are common
